title: Catalyst Entity Type Definition (ETD) Schema
description: JSON schema for validating entity type definition YAML files in Catalyst framework modules.

grounding.description: `required` (links directly to the grounding type), `inherited` (through a parent entity), or `none`.

grounding_field.description: Field holding the grounding link; required unless `grounding` is `none`.

name.description: Exact field name in the artifact file.

required.description: Whether every instance must carry it.

target_type.description: Target entity prefix (or kernel type such as `rule`) for `ref` / `ref-list`.

backref.description: The field on the target that lists this entity back. That field is **derived**: catalyst writes it (`catalyst new`, `catalyst link`), `catalyst check` reports it as the `derived` error when it disagrees with its sources, and `catalyst repair derived` rewrites it, journaled. Never edit it by hand.

required_when_closed.description: For a field that is not `required`: it must be non-empty once the artifact's `Status` is one of the workflow's `closed_states` (e.g. an item may not close without the sub-items recording its work). `catalyst validate` reports a violation as the `closed-incomplete` error (`CLI.md`). Default `false`.

hint.description: What the item template's cell tells the artifact's author, in place of the kind's placeholder (format 3; `catalyst new` writes an optional field it is not given as `*(none yet)*`).

guards.description: State → the conditions entering it requires, each one of `children_closed: <field>` (every artifact the field cites is in a closed state), `nonempty: <field>`, `section_written: <heading>` (the section's text differs from the type's template's), `holds: <condition>` (a condition on its fields, e.g. `Classification at least Confidential`: `<Field> is|is not|in|not in|at least|at most <value>` or `<Field> is set|is empty`, ordered by the field's enum values, else as numbers or dates). `catalyst status set` refuses to enter a state while one fails (`--force` overrides it, journaled); `catalyst check` warns about an artifact already in a guarded state that fails one.

due.description: When an open entity of the type is due: a date field (`Due`), or a date field plus days (`Checked + 30 days`). Past it, `catalyst inbox` lists it as `overdue`, with the role a governing workflow escalates to, and `catalyst check` warns.

naming.description: `id-summary` (default: `<ID>-<short-summary>.md`, INV-7) or `free-form` (files keyed by a free name, exempt from INV-7).

location.description: Parent of `folder` inside the working copy, e.g. `development` for `development/<folder>/`. Default: the working-copy root. `catalyst init` creates the folder there and the CLI looks for it there first.
